title: 40-day-old girl with seizure
arrival: A 40-day-old girl is brought in by her parents after a seizure at home. She has had a fever, cough, and a runny nose for three days.
keyCriterion: Red — Other: age <2 months with temperature <36° or >39°C
feedbackWhy: She is 40 days old, therefore younger than 2 months, with a temperature of 40.5°C, above the 39° threshold.

airway_red.text: No stridor. No central cyanosis. No respiratory distress.

disability_red.text: Seizure at home. Not having active convulsions. Consolable and interactive. No altered mental status.

airway_yellow.text: Cough and runny nose. No swelling of the mouth, throat or neck. No wheezing.

circulation_yellow.text: No vomiting or diarrhoea. No severe pallor.

exampleShows: She is under 2 months old, and her temperature of 40.5°C is above the 39° threshold.
Age and temperature together meet a red criterion under Other.
